notes: "Kekerasan air (GH) 4–20 dGH": the facts give GH 4–20 with no unit, so 'dGH' is a small addition.
"Jangka hayat ... 10–15 tahun (sumber lain)": this is supported by the facts (source 8).

"Ia sukar mencari makanan" and "ia perenang yang lemah" in the beginner FAQ: these are supported, but they are presented as reasons the source gave for 'not suitable for beginners'. The facts don't state that link.
"Boleh, tetapi hanya dengan ikan yang perlahan": this leaves out the advice to keep it apart, which is minor.
"Siapa sebenarnya penternak pertamanya tidak direkodkan" – not in the facts (unsupported claim).
"10–15 tahun (sumber lain)" is supported, but the intro says "penglihatannya terhad" – facts say vision is impaired, which is acceptable.
"sediakan tangki ... penapis yang disediakan khas" / "ia perlukan tangki dan penapis yang disediakan khas" – generalisation not directly stated.
"kantungnya mudah pecah" given as the reason it is not suitable for beginners – facts only say not suitable for beginners, with no reason given.
"Ada juga yang memberi salad dan timun" – facts say lettuce and cucumber, and "salad" is a loose rendering of lettuce.
Size "10–20 cm" – facts say 10–20.3 cm; this is roughly acceptable.
Care table GH "4–20" has no unit; this is minor.
"Sumber menyarankan kolam kira-kira 3,800 liter seekor dengan kedalaman sekurang-kurangnya 90 cm hingga lebih 1 m" is a mild merge of two sources. It is supported.
"Ia hidup lama dan boleh membesar dengan besar, jadi rancang kolam yang cukup luas sebelum membeli" is a small generality and is not stated as a recommendation in the facts.
"Kolam simen menaikkan pH, jadi kolam jenis ini perlu dikedap" is supported.
"Pada tahun 1980-an" and "sekitar 1982" are supported.
The heading "Rakan sekolam" and the answer "Boleh, kerana penjagaannya hampir sama" are slight paraphrases. They are supported.
"Sumber yang sama menegaskan" ties the 'not goldfish' statement to the 'Asian carp' source. This matches source 2.
"Pada ikan yang jarang ditemui, siripnya sepanjang badan" matches the facts.
"Sesetengah peminat di Jepun" matches the facts.
"Penternak koi pakar" is supported.
"Sirip dan ekornya... dua pertiga" is supported.

"kolam tanpa objek tajam sangat penting" and "ikan ini boleh hidup puluhan tahun dan membesar besar": mild generalisations. The first rests on the sharp-objects fact, but the 'sangat penting' emphasis is an addition.

"Dijual di kedai ikan hiasan dan kedai kolam": the facts say 'pet and pond shops', so this is a fair paraphrase. The 'Kolam' table row merges two sources (90 cm and >1 m) into one range, which is acceptable.
"tidak terlalu terdedah kepada arus yang kuat": slight embellishment of the advice about slow swimming in strong currents.
"kolam simen ... permukaannya perlu disalut atau dikedap": 'disalut' (coated) is not in the facts. The facts only say to seal the pond.
"Sirip terus memanjang apabila ikan semakin tua, jadi ikan dewasa mempunyai sirip paling panjang": the facts support this, since older fish have the longest fins.
"Ikan itu kurang laku, lalu Blue Ridge ... mengacukkannya dengan koi": supported.
"Air yang bersih, kolam tanpa objek tajam dan pengendalian yang berhati-hati membantu mengelakkannya" (in the FAQ): this implies prevention of torn fins. It is mostly supported.
"Ikan dasar yang besar atau ikan pari mungkin sesuai" is supported.
"Tangki perlu panjang, tidak perlu dalam" is a fair rendering of "long rather than deep".
"Paling sesuai dipelihara seekor sahaja" slightly strengthens the facts' "Keep it as a single display fish". This is minor.
"Sumber pertama turut menyebut isipadu" is supported only loosely. The 600–1,000 L figure is from source 6, which also gives 180–200 cm, so this is fine.
"Ladang-ladang inilah yang membekalkan kebanyakan ikan gred tinggi untuk eksport" is supported.
"Ia membesar sehingga kira-kira 90 cm" is supported.
The intro's "bentuk warna emas Scleropages formosus" is a mild generalisation. The facts call it a variety based on S. formosus.
"Cuba beli dari ladang yang bereputasi" is supported.
"Ikan ini tidak sesuai untuk pemula" – the facts give difficulty 5 but no explicit beginner statement; mild inference, and the reasons given (size, clean water, sturdy lid) are not stated as reasons.

"tangki sepanjang 180–200 cm dengan isipadu kira-kira 600–1,000 liter" – the facts give 600–1,000 L from one source and 180–200 cm from the same source; this is acceptable, but linking them is an inference.
"Minta kedua-dua dokumen ini" – advice to ask for both documents is not in the facts.

"nama jenis atau 'ketulenan' yang dinyatakan oleh penjual tidak semestinya tepat" – an unsupported claim about seller-stated names and purity; the facts only say farms cross types and purity is reduced.
"Di sesetengah tempat, ada juga pemilik yang membuat pembedahan kosmetik" – the facts say this happens in Vietnam, and the page drops the price and the location (generalised).
"Pada ikan muda, pastikan warna emasnya sedang menuju ke baris itu" – an extension, loosely supported by the buying advice.
"Ada penggemar yang menasihatkan cahaya lembut untuk arowana emas" – the facts say gentle lighting for Kim Long (Vietnamese keepers); this is generalised and the attribution is blurred.
"air yang bersih" in the intro is a generality; the facts say soft, slightly acidic, well-filtered water.
"24–27 °C" for Source B: the fact says 24.4–26.7, which rounds to about 24–27 °C, so this is acceptable.
"Ikan jantan juga tidak boleh dipelihara bersama jantan lain" is in the intro under the buying advice. It is supported, but it is placed oddly.
"Dua sumber menilai tahap kesukarannya sebagai 2" is supported, but the page gives no scale. This is a small generality.
"Ada juga sumber yang menyenaraikan beberapa negara Asia Tenggara" is vague. The fact names Thailand, Cambodia, Indonesia and Vietnam. This is minor.
"Ikan jantan membina sarang buih dan menjaga telur" is supported.

The intro says the webbing is "lebih pendek" and the page says "Satu sumber lain pula menganggap ia lebih sukar dijaga ... jejarinya mudah melengkung jika kualiti air tidak dijaga". The fact says only that the long rays curl without careful care. Tying this to water quality is a slight embellishment.
"hujung jejari boleh reput dan tercabut" is a slight stretch of "crumble off". It is acceptable.
"Kerosakan akibat ammonia tidak boleh pulih" is supported.
"Kitaran nitrogen yang sudah matang dan tukar air yang konsisten sangat penting" is not in the facts.
"Thailand, Kemboja dan Indonesia sebagai negara asal" omits Vietnam from the listed origins. This is a small change.
"jadi asal usulnya agak jelas" is an added conclusion that the facts do not state.
"24–27 °C (sumber lain)" rounds 24.4–26.7 °C. This is acceptable rounding.
"Jadi pertimbangkan perkara ini sebelum membuat pesanan" is advice not found in the facts.

"Punca yang biasa ialah kualiti air yang buruk" in the FAQ presents poor water as the usual cause of curling. The facts say high ammonia causes curling, and they also say long rays curl without careful care.
"Boleh" in the FAQ on mixing crowntails with other fish is a stronger yes than the facts give. They list suitable tankmates, but they also describe crowntails as aggressive.
The kept-tank-size claim "sirip panjangnya tidak rosak" is supported. "Sirip ventral bergerigi" is supported as a Vietnamese buyers' preference.

"Udang Taiwan bee seperti Red Ruby ... bukan sebahagian daripada tangga gred crystal red" – the facts don't say Red Ruby is outside the grade ladder (one Vietnamese shop lists 'Red Ruby' as a top grade).
"pembiakan baka terpilih menyebabkan strain ini mempunyai kepelbagaian genetik yang rendah" – the facts say line breeding, not selective breeding in general. This is a minor change of wording.
"Ia memerlukan air lembut dan sejuk" – 'sejuk' is a generalisation. The facts give 'cool' only for oxygen-rich water, and the temperature ranges go up to 26 °C.

"Betina yang sedia membiak menunjukkan ovari berbentuk pelana berwarna putih kekuningan" – this merges two sources. One describes a saddle-shaped ovary and the other a whitish-yellow saddle on the back.

"Satu sumber menyarankan ... Ammonia dan nitrat sepatutnya sifar" – the sentence follows the 'same source' temperature advice, but the facts credit the ammonia and nitrate advice to a different source. This is a small misattribution.
"Satu sumber berpendapat warna putih tambahan ... berkemungkinan besar datang daripada udang golden bee" – this is supported. The wording is fine.
"kebanyakan sumber merujuk kepada Jepun" – the facts don't say that most sources point to Japan; it is only a mild generalisation, but the facts list one source for Taiwan and others for Japan.
"Sebelum membeli, sediakan tangki yang sudah matang" and "dalam tangki yang sudah matang" – the facts never mention a mature or cycled tank.
"Udang ini dianggap agak cerewet. Ia perlukan air lembut yang sejuk dan stabil" – 'stable' water is not stated as a requirement. The facts only mention sensitivity to temperature and pH changes.
"Mulakan dengan sekumpulan udang gred rendah yang sihat, sekitar 10–20 ekor" in the intro, plus the FAQ advice to start with grade A or low grade – a loose blend of the sources.
"Kebanyakannya sekitar 20–25 °C" – the facts show 20–25 °C from only one of four sources, so 'most' is unsupported.
"Gen hitam adalah dominan" and "Udang dewasa tidak mengganggu anak-anaknya" are supported. But "saiz dewasanya sekitar 2.5–3.5 cm" merges the ranges and is fine.

"Ingat juga bahawa label gred seperti SSSS atau 'Red Ruby' ditambah oleh sesetengah penjual sahaja, bukan sebahagian daripada tangga gred biasa" – the facts attribute this to a search snippet only. The facts also say Red Ruby is a separate Taiwan bee mutation, which the page does not reconcile with using it as a top-grade label.
"Anak hibrid selalunya masih mengekalkan sedikit warna putih" – the facts say 'the young often keep some white'. The page widens the sense of 'hybrid'.
"Beberapa sumber tidak mengesyorkannya untuk pemula" – the facts support one article advising beginners to avoid it, and one source calling it fussy.
"Guppy Dumbo ialah barisan guppy ... hasil pembiakan terpilih" is supported, but the intro "sesuai dengan air yang tenang" is a mild generalisation from the facts.
"Satu sumber mencadangkan aliran penapis yang perlahan hingga sederhana" is faithful; no other significant unsupported claims found.
The page lists "Saiz dewasa" as 3–5 cm; 5 cm; 6.4 cm, which matches the facts.
The intro's "sirip dadanya yang besar mudah koyak" is supported by the source 2 fact.
"Sumber-sumber menilainya mudah hingga sederhana untuk dijaga" – the facts only give difficulty scores 2 and 4 on unspecified scales; "mudah hingga sederhana" is an invented interpretation.
"Hujung atas julat suhu, iaitu 28 °C, sama dalam semua sumber" – derived claim, but the facts do not state it. It is arithmetically true, so only a minor issue.
"Bagi pH, kebanyakan sumber bertindih di sekitar 7–7.5" – unsupported synthesis. Source 2 gives 6.5–7.5 and source 4 gives 7–8.5; this is an inference, not a fact.

"Antara tempat utama ikan ini diternak termasuklah Thailand dan Indonesia" – the facts name Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam, and the page leaves out Vietnam. It also does not attribute the claim to a Vietnamese article.
"Ikan yang 'telinganya' besar dan seimbang serta warnanya stabil lebih dihargai" – the facts say this only for Vietnam, and the page presents it as general.
"Seperti guppy lain, ia ikan yang melahirkan anak ... dan mudah dibiakkan" – this is fine, but "Menurut satu sumber, ia mudah dijaga" and "Ikan ini aman" are stated as general fact.
"Penilaian kesukaran ... masing-masing pada skala sendiri" – the facts do not say the scales differ. This is an invented claim.

"Kalau menggunakan penapis biasa, pastikan alirannya perlahan hingga sederhana" – the facts say gentle to moderate flow, so this is fine. The FAQ line "aliran penapis perlahan" drops the "moderate" part.
"sekitar 208 liter atau lebih" – the facts say 55 gallons or more; the page converts it to 208 L, which is fine. Not a problem.
"Satu sumber memberi kira-kira 12.7 cm" is supported (source 6).

"malah ada yang mencapai 16.5–20 cm" duplicates the forum figure as if it were an extra claim. The facts give 16.5–20 cm for forum keepers, and 15–20 cm comes from a different source. The page blends them as "kira-kira 15–20 cm, malah... 16.5–20 cm", which is slightly muddled.

"Ikan ini juga gemar menggali" in the intro is supported, but "sebaliknya bentuk warna blue acara hasil pembiakan terpilih" in the FAQ is attributed to the retailer who said it is not a hybrid. That retailer's statement as given in the facts is only that it is not a hybrid and not dyed.
"sedangkan spesies ini hidup liar di Trinidad, Venezuela dan Colombia" combines two sources as if settled fact. The facts show these as separate sources' ranges.
"Ada kedai yang menjual ikan bersaiz 6–7 cm" is supported.
"Pasangan yang cukup makan akan menuntut satu kawasan" is supported.
"Ikan ini bertelur di atas batu yang rata" is supported.
"Ada sumber yang mengatakan ia tidak sukar dijaga... paling sesuai dalam tangki yang stabil" is supported.
The "gantian" tank range "100 liter, sekitar 115 liter atau sekitar 150 liter" is supported.
"lebih baik jika sekitar 210 liter ke atas" – facts say 55 gallons or more preferred; 55 gallons ≈ 208 L, so this is acceptable, but "sekitar 210 liter" is a slight rounding.
"Spesies asalnya berasal dari Amerika Selatan" – the facts give only Trinidad, Venezuela and Colombia, with no continent stated (a small generalisation).
"Sediakan juga tempat bersembunyi dan ruang berenang yang terbuka" – hiding places come from one source and open swimming space from another; they are combined into one recommendation.
"Ikan ini secara umumnya tidak sukar dijaga" in the intro – this is combined from sources that disagree on hardiness.
"Kebanyakan sumber menyatakan ia ialah bentuk warna blue acara ... hasil pembiakan terpilih" – the "most sources" claim is a count the facts do not give.
"Saiz yang biasa dilaporkan ialah 10–15 cm" in the FAQ – the facts give several size ranges and do not say 10–15 cm is the usual one.
"Electric Blue Acara biasanya dijual lebih mahal" – the facts say only that they sell for more, so "biasanya" is a small addition.
"Sebelum membeli, sediakan tangki sekurang-kurangnya 100 liter" – the facts give the minimum as 100 L, but other sources say about 115 L or about 150 L.
"jentik-jentik boleh digunakan untuk menarik seleranya": the facts say mosquito larvae can tempt them to eat. Rendering this as jentik-jentik is fine, so this is only a minor point.
"Beli daripada kedai ikan hiasan atau penternak yang dipercayai": the facts say only "trusted dealer or breeder". Specifying an ornamental fish shop is a small embellishment.

"Sumber menasihatkan supaya ikan ini tidak dimasukkan ke dalam tangki yang baru disediakan kerana ia sensitif terhadap nitrat": the facts list the two points separately and do not state this causal link. It is a mild inference.

"Ikan sebegini lebih lemah, jangka hayatnya lebih pendek, dan warnanya boleh pudar kemudian": the FAQ merges the hormone claims from separate sources into one statement. This is consistent with the facts.
"Cara paling murah untuk mendapatkan sepasang" appears in the sexing FAQ answer. It is supported by the facts, but it sits oddly as an answer to that question.
"Tunggu sehingga kitaran nitrogen benar-benar stabil." – not in the facts (the nitrogen cycle is never mentioned).
"membiarkan mereka berpasangan sendiri" – the facts only say that buying a group of juveniles is the cheapest way to get a pair. The pairing-off part is an added detail.

"Ada yang menganggapnya agak sukar dan ada yang menganggapnya lebih mudah" – the facts give only difficulty numbers (4 and 2), with no wording about which is harder or easier. This is a mild paraphrase.
"Ikan ini dianggap cerewet" – the facts say "demanding" for the fish, but only as Practical Fishkeeping's wording. The page states it as general opinion.
"jentik-jentik boleh digunakan untuk menarik seleranya" – this is fine (mosquito larvae). The "Ikan ini sensitif... mudah dijangkiti" lead is also supported.
"penyakit bintik putih (white spot)" - the facts say ich; white spot is a fair translation, so this is fine. Ignore this note.
"Sesetengah peminat pula percaya corak pada badannya menyerupai tulisan Cina" - in the facts this is a Vietnam claim about the name's origin, not a Malaysian one. Minor.

"Sesetengah stok jenis badan bulat bermutiara putih yang dibiak baka dalam telah merosot" - the facts say 'some inbred kim cương stock'. Equating kim cương with the round-bodied La Hán kim cương line is acceptable.
"Jenis yang diternak terutamanya di Thailand mempunyai kepala merah, badan kuning jingga" - the facts attach this to Kim Hoa / Kim Cương Thái đỏ (King Kamfa), so this is supported.
"Satu sumber menilai louhan sebagai ikan yang agak mencabar" - the facts give only difficulty 4, with no scale. 'Agak mencabar' (fairly challenging) is an invented interpretation.
"Lebih 60 jenis louhan dilaporkan wujud" - supported.

"Louhan ialah cichlid hibrid ... dihasilkan oleh penternak di Malaysia pada tahun 1990-an" - this firmly states Malaysian origin. The facts support it only partly, since they say breeders crossed fish there by about 1994.
"Seorang penternak berpendapat" - the facts say a forum keeper, so this is fine.
"Ia perlukan air panas yang bersih" - generic, but roughly supported by the temperature facts.
"betina hanya ada kok kecil atau tiada langsung" - the facts say 'little or none', so this is supported.
"Penyakit bintik putih (white spot)": facts say ich, so this is okay, but the page lists it as its own entry with 'juga biasa berlaku' — minor.
"Trimac ... dianggap induk yang paling pasti" — OK; but "Louhan dihasilkan di Malaysia" stated flatly is fine.

"Jenis golden base dan jenis berwarna putih dianggap jenis premium": the facts say this about Vietnam (Hoàng Kim and Tuyết Điêu – Bạch Ngọc), not in general; the 'putih' line is only loosely supported.
"Midas ... dan redhead cichlid ... turut dicadangkan": ok. But "Nico ... merumuskan ... berkemungkinan besar hibrid" is supported.
"sekitar 10–12 tahun": facts give 10–12 and 10; ok.
"Jenis berlian ... (Kim Cương)" and "Thai Silk" lack the Vietnam 2008 context; harmless.
"Masalah pencernaan ... terutamanya apabila air sejuk atau ikan diberi makan berlebihan": combines separate facts into a health claim; mildly unsupported.
"Kamfa ... jenis yang diternak terutamanya di Thailand mempunyai kepala merah, badan kuning jingga": facts attribute this to Kim Hoa / King Kamfa, so this is fine.
"Seorang penternak berpendapat" — facts say a Vietnamese forum keeper; fine.

"Ikan ini agak mencabar ... suhu yang panas dan stabil": 'stabil' (stable) is not in the facts; small unsupported generality. Also "Sebab itu penternak bergilir-gilir" and 'Over 60 lines' are supported.

"jangan beri terlalu banyak" is fine, but "Seorang penjaga di forum meragui baka albino merah boleh membiak lebih daripada kira-kira 75 peratus mengikut baka induk" is a slight reinterpretation of "breed true"; acceptable but loosely worded.
"Satu sumber lain memberinya skor kesukaran 2, tetapi tidak menyatakan skalanya" – the facts give no information on whether a scale was stated; this is an inference not in the facts.
"kotak polisterin" for foam boxes is fine, but "tangki bertumbuhan akuatik" is fine; "kolam simen" for cement tanks is fine.
"Jika kedua-dua induk membawa gen albino" – facts say 'two carrier parents', roughly equal; acceptable.

"Sumber tidak sepakat tentang kesukarannya... mudah terkejut apabila keadaan air atau cahaya berubah" – the intro attributes both water and light shock to one shop, whereas the facts attribute light sensitivity to other sources; minor blending.
"Albino kurang jelas penglihatannya" is supported, but the FAQ's "Jauhkan bentuk albino daripada ikan yang agresif" is fine.
"Sebuah kedai di Amerika Syarikat menyifatkan bentuk albino Full Red sebagai strain warna yang lebih baharu" is supported.
"Ikan jantan lebih kecil" and the red-eyed albino description are supported; "Albino mata merah: badan, sirip dan matanya merah" slightly extends the facts.
"Lebih penting ialah mengelakkan perubahan suhu yang mengejut" is not in the facts (temperature advice invented).
"Ada bentuk bermata hitam dan bentuk albino bermata merah" is supported, but "Jadi asal-usul sebenarnya tidak didokumentasikan dengan jelas" is an inference not stated in the facts.
"tangki bertumbuhan akuatik" and "kotak polisterina" are paraphrases; they are acceptable but slightly loose.
"Tahap kesukarannya... sumber lain menilainya sebagai ikan yang mudah dijaga" is a loose reading of difficulty 2 (of unspecified scale) as 'easy'.
"Boleh. Ikan ini aman" and the claim that the albino should avoid aggressive fish are supported. "mudah terkejut ... akibat tukar air secara mengejut atau cahaya terang" is supported.
"Satu artikel kedai pula menyebut Thailand dan Taiwan" omits Vietnam in the shop's own listing, but it is not wrong.
"seperti kipas" for the BDS dorsal is a mild elaboration of 'fanning'.
"Penjagaannya mudah dan sama seperti spesies asalnya" is a mild generalisation. The facts give difficulty 2 from one source and say the company claims the same care as other fish of the species.
"Mereka membiak dalam hampir setiap tempoh persampelan" is attributed to the Magalhães study. It is supported, but the page frames it as the same group's finding.

"Lesennya juga melarang pembiakan dan penjualan anak, dan beberapa negara tidak membenarkan ikan ini langsung" in the intro is an unsupported generalisation. The facts only name the EU, Brazil's import ban and California's earlier ban.
"Jangan terkejut jika ikan nampak biasa sahaja di bawah lampu kedai" is advice not in the facts, though it follows from them.
"Idea menjualnya sebagai ikan hiasan datang kemudian" is supported. "Protein ... daripada haiwan laut" in the intro is supported too.
The FAQ says "Tidak susah" and gives "suhu sekitar 22–28 °C". Both are acceptable summaries of the facts.
"Penjagaannya ... sama seperti spesies asalnya" in the FAQ states company-claimed care as plain fact. This is a minor unsupported generalisation.

"Sumber tidak sependapat tentang tahap kesukarannya. Ada yang memberinya penilaian 1 dan ada yang memberinya 4": difficulty ratings are in the facts, but the page words them loosely as a general claim.
"Ada kedai yang menjual bentuk warna seperti red dragon": the facts say Vietnamese shops, and the page drops that.
"Ada artikel kedai yang menyatakan ... dibiakkan di Thailand": the facts say Vietnamese shop articles, and the page drops that. This is minor.
"Ada penjaga yang membela ikan laga dalam tangki kecil tanpa pam udara": the facts say Vietnamese keepers, and the page drops that. This is minor.
"Satu sumber menyebut minimum kira-kira 15 liter" and "tangki 15 cm": both are in the facts. The FAQ line about "mangkuk plastik kecil tanpa penapis" is also supported. Nothing is wrong here.

"Rosetail dibangunkan oleh Masillamoni dan Chenot sekitar tahun 1989": the facts say this about the feathertail, or the rosetail line in general, so the page may have shifted the attribution slightly. This is minor.
"Ekor ... boleh layu": the facts say the tail can collapse, so "layu" (wilt) is a slightly loose translation.
"Sumber tidak sependapat tentang tahap kesukarannya" - the facts give difficulty ratings (1 and 4), but the page's follow-on claim "Asas penjagaannya sama seperti ikan laga lain" is not in the facts.

"sirip yang besar dan berat lebih mudah rosak jika kualiti air tidak dijaga" - this is a generalisation. The facts say dirty water harms fins and heavy tails tire the fish, but they don't say large fins are more prone to damage.
"Ada juga artikel kedai yang menyatakan bahawa ikan laga halfmoon kini kebanyakannya dibiakkan di Thailand" - the facts say it is "mainly bred in Thailand". The word "kini" (now) is added.
"jantannya berhenti membina sarang buih" - the facts say males stopped building nests. "Buih" (bubble) is an added detail.
"Ikan laga halfmoon ialah bentuk ekor ... yang dibiakkan oleh penternak" - this is generic and loosely supported. It is not a serious problem.

"Ada penjaga yang membela ikan laga dalam tangki kecil tanpa pam udara, dan mereka mengelakkan hiasan yang tajam supaya sirip tidak koyak" - the facts only say they avoid sharp decorations. The reason "supaya sirip tidak koyak" is inferred.
"Halfmoon ialah ikan karnivor" is supported, but "jejari patah dan ekor boleh layu" for "tail can collapse" is a loose rendering. It is acceptable.
"hasil pemilihan baka selama dua abad" – facts say breeding began in the 1820s, but "two centuries" is not stated.
"satu sumber menilainya mudah, satu lagi menilainya sukar" – facts give difficulty 5 and 2 with no wording of easy or hard. This is an interpretation.
"boleh membesar hingga 50–91 cm" – this merges size ranges from two sources (61–91 and 50–81). It is acceptable but is a combined figure.
"dua sumber lain menyebut 7–7.5" – supported (sources 1 and 4).
"Butterfly koi juga berenang lebih perlahan" – the facts say 'slower swimmers', so this is supported.
"Cuba minta penjual beri makan sebelum anda membeli" – the facts say test-feed before buying. It is slightly reworded.
"Sebelum membeli, pastikan anda ada ... penapis yang baik" – the filter advice comes from the Japanese-style pond fact, so this is a mild generalisation.
"Koi tidak sukar dijaga" – the facts conflict (difficulty 5 vs 2); the page flatly says not hard in the intro, which is an unsupported general claim.
"Ikan yang sudah ditinggalkan dalam penjagaan juga tetap memerlukan kuarantin yang ketat" – this garbled claim about abandoned fish is not in the facts.
"boleh hidup berpuluh tahun" and "badannya membesar hingga 50–91 cm" – the sizes are combined from different sources; this is acceptable but loose.
"Ginrin Red Chagoi dan Tancho pula antara koi yang paling dihargai oleh sesetengah peminat" – the facts say they are most prized in Vietnam; the page generalises this.
"Ramai peminat membahagikan koi kepada koi biasa..." – the facts attribute this split to Vietnamese hobbyists; "ramai peminat" is a generalisation.
"Pertandingan di Amerika Syarikat pula selalunya menyenaraikannya dalam kelas berasingan" – this is supported (US shows often list them separately).
"Pastikan sirip dan sisiknya sempurna" – this is supported only by the quarantine source and is placed under buying; minor.
"dua sumber lain menyebut 7–7.5" – this is supported (sources 1 and 4).
"Butterfly koi berenang lebih perlahan" – this is supported by "slower swimmers".
"bersama ikan lain yang sesuai dengan suhu sejuk yang sama" – this is supported.
"Selain nama dalam tajuk itu, penternaknya tidak diterangkan lebih lanjut" – facts say the breeder is not named beyond that; implying the name in the title is the breeder is a slight stretch.
"Satu panduan kedai memberinya tahap kesukaran 2, dan keperluannya sama seperti angelfish lain" – 'same needs as other angelfish' is not in the facts.
"Koi makan semua jenis makanan ikan" – the facts say it eats everything or dry, live and frozen foods; 'all kinds of fish food' is a mild generalisation.
"Koi subur dan pernah digunakan dalam kacukan luar" followed by 'biasa sahaja' – the facts' 'plain' silver gold marble ghost is rendered loosely.
"mutasi warna angelfish telah dikekalkan melalui pembiakan dalam sejak tahun 1950-an" – the facts say 'colour mutations' generally; this is acceptable but not tied to koi.
"Barisan merah atau berliputan tinggi yang paling terang pun" – 'paling terang' is an embellishment of 'bright red/high-coverage line'.

FAQ: "Barisan berliputan tinggi pun masih menghasilkan sebahagian anak yang kurang merah" as an answer to whether two koi give all koi – a stretch, since the facts treat this as red fry, not non-koi offspring.
"Saiz dewasa 12–15 cm; satu sumber menyebut 15 cm" – this is a reasonable merge, but the sources are mislabelled.
"Jadi koi bukan ikan hibrid." / "Adakah angelfish koi ikan hibrid? Tidak." – the facts never address hybrid status; it's an added claim (though implied by colour form).
"Ikan ini tidak susah dijaga" / "tergolong dalam kategori mudah hingga sederhana" – the facts only give difficulty 2 from one source; the 'easy to moderate' category is invented.
"walaupun ada penjual yang menjanjikannya" – sellers promising coverage is not in the facts.
"Nama 'Red Devil' kadangkala digunakan seolah-olah barisan istimewa" – a rephrasing of the marketing-name dispute that is not supported as stated.
"Ramai mencadangkan tangki yang tinggi, panjangnya sekitar 100–120 cm" – 'many' recommend a tall tank is a generalisation; only some sources do.
"Koi Red: Dijual di Jerman sebagai ikan baka Jerman (DNZ)" – reworded slightly, but roughly supported.

"Pasangan bertelur ... setiap 10–14 hari" is placed as a general fact about koi, but it comes from a shop guide; "Angelfish koi subur dan sering digunakan dalam kacukan luar" – 'often used' is a slight stretch.
"Tinggi ikan dewasa ... 26 cm" was used to argue that a taller, larger tank is more comfortable – an added recommendation not in the facts.
No clear unsupported claims found; minor: the 'Satu sumber lain menyebut ukuran tangki sekitar 17–20 cm' is reproduced from the facts, though it is an odd figure.
"Penjagaannya sama seperti ikan laga biasa": a general statement that the facts don't make directly.
"Penilaian tahap kesukaran ... satu menilainya agak sukar, satu lagi agak mudah": the facts give only the numbers 4 and 2, with no scale or wording. "Agak sukar" and "agak mudah" are interpretations.
"corak ikan muda masih boleh berubah sehingga usia sekitar setahun": the facts only give a 6-to-12-month example. They set no age limit for the pattern changing.
"Asal usul bentuk koi sendiri tidak didokumenkan dengan jelas": the facts show conflicting accounts but never say the origin is undocumented.
Minor: "tidak menyatakan skala yang digunakan" (the scale is not stated) is not in the facts, though it is a harmless remark.
Minor: the intro's "Ia perlukan ... tukar air setiap minggu" is supported, but the FAQ framing "Sumber berbeza pendapat" is an editorial gloss.
"warnanya cepat pudar apabila kualiti air menurun": the facts say pale-bodied fish show stress quickly when water quality drops. They don't say the colour fades.

"Ikan ini agak mudah dijaga" and "Satu sumber menilainya sebagai ikan yang agak mudah dijaga": the facts give only a difficulty value of 2 with no scale or label, so "fairly easy" is an interpretation.

"Pastikan juga air sentiasa bersih dan stabil kerana ikan berbadan pucat cepat stres": this is a reasonable extension of the facts, but the facts give no advice on keeping the red colour through water quality.

"Lionhead, ranchu dan lionchu ada persamaan, jadi periksa sendiri...": the fact only says that in Vietnam 'lan thọ' is used for both lionhead and ranchu. It doesn't mention lionchu or the Vietnam context.
"Kuarantin ikan baharu sebelum dimasukkan ke dalam tangki utama": the fact only says to quarantine new fish. 'Main tank' is a small addition.

"Oleh itu, ia memerlukan arus perlahan, hiasan yang licin dan pemakanan yang seimbang": this links weak swimming and swim bladder problems to those care needs. The facts don't state the link, and 'balanced feeding' is a paraphrase.

FAQ: "Ranchu sebenarnya dikembangkan di Jepun daripada Lionhead" is stated as flat fact. The facts only say Lionhead was the precursor of the Ranchu. The "sebenarnya" framing turns that into a correction, which is unsupported.
"Kenapa sebahagian anak Lionhead ada sirip belakang?" is answered correctly, but "Mendapat 40 peratus anak tanpa sirip belakang sudah dikira sangat baik" is acceptable. The question itself is fine.
"Jangka hayat 10–15 tahun" merges two sources (15 and 10–15). It is a small, acceptable generalisation.
"Lionchu ... yang dihasilkan di Thailand" is supported. "Lionhead sering digelar padanan Cina bagi ranchu Jepun" is supported.

"Nama Lionhead dan ranchu kadangkala bercampur aduk dalam jualan" is slightly generalised. The facts say 'lan thọ' is mixed up in Vietnam, so the page drops the Vietnam context and the 'lan thọ' name.
"Ada juga penternak yang memelihara Lionhead dalam air cetek" is attributed to breeders. The facts call it Vietnamese practice and do not say breeders.
"Menurut satu sumber, ia berasal daripada Egg Fish" is supported. "Dari China" in the intro is supported.
"Ikan ini perenang lemah dan lebih mudah mendapat masalah pundi renang" is supported. The facts say it is more prone than the ranchu, and the page omits that comparison in the intro.
"Belakangnya licin tanpa bonjol, lekuk atau duri sirip belakang" is slightly altered. The facts say no bumps, dips or dorsal spikes.
"Pilih ikan yang jambulnya meliputi ketiga-tiga bahagian (atas kepala, muka dan penutup insang)" is acceptable.
"Glaser, sebuah syarikat pengimport dari Jerman": the facts only call Glaser "a German importer". They don't say it is a company, so "syarikat" is a small unsupported detail.
"jadi tangki boleh penuh dengan anak dalam masa singkat" is a mild extrapolation. The facts say they breed easily, but they don't say the tank fills up quickly.
"(semua anaknya bertanda sama)" is an added gloss on "breed true". The facts don't spell this out.
"menghasilkan kira-kira 75 peratus anak bertanda" is the page's own sum of 50% and 25%. It is consistent with the facts, but the source never states it.
"seperti cacing darah, kutu air atau artemia" - specific live foods (bloodworm, water fleas, artemia) are not in the facts.
"satu sumber menganggapnya agak mudah" - the facts give only difficulty numbers (2 and 4) with no scale. Calling 2 "agak mudah" is an unsupported interpretation.
"Jadi, ikan muda di kedai ikan hiasan biasanya belum menunjukkan rupa sebenar ikan itu apabila dewasa" - this generalisation is not in the facts.
"iaitu umur wen mula tumbuh" - linking the 6-month buying advice to wen onset is the page's own inference. The two facts come from different sources.
"ikan ini perlukan air bersih yang stabil, tangki yang luas" - 'stable' water and 'spacious' tank are loose generalities. The facts give no such wording.
"seperti cacing darah dan artemia": the facts only say live or frozen food now and then. Bloodworms and brine shrimp are not named.
"Bahagian ini paling penting untuk ikan ini": the facts do not rank feeding as the most important part of care.
"Ia mempunyai satu atau dua bonjol seperti gelembung di kepala": this mixes two facts. The Crown has one or two lumps, and the bubble-like domes are the two large domes of the head form.

"Kedua-dua sumber ini menyatakan ... mungkin lebih sihat dan lebih panjang umur": only one source says healthier and longer-lived. The other says only that single-tailed goldfish have fewer health problems.
"Jika rumah anda panas, berikan perhatian kepada suhu air": this is a generic recommendation not in the facts.
FAQ: "tekanan yang rendah" is listed as reducing peppering. The facts say stress can bring peppering out, but they don't say low stress reduces it, so this is a mild extrapolation.
Intro: "seperti discus lain, ia perlukan tangki besar, air yang sangat bersih" generalises the Vietnamese keepers' advice into a general claim.
"jadi kuarantin ikan baharu amat berguna": the facts never recommend quarantining new fish. This is an unsupported addition.
"Kebanyakan sumber menilainya mudah dijaga" is a slight generalisation. The facts give difficulty ratings of 2, 2 and 4, and they don't say what those numbers mean.
"kerana setiap jenis dinilai mengikut piawaian yang berbeza" is a mild generalisation. The facts describe different standards only for some types.
"fokus menyerang sirip lawan" – the facts only say "fin focus"; attacking the opponent's fins is an invented interpretation.
"jangan sekali-kali melepaskan ikan hiasan ke dalam sungai atau tasik" – this recommendation is not in the facts.
"Nemo Koi bergantung pada salasilah dan keunikan warna" – the facts say ancestry affects fighters' prices and only colour affects Nemo Koi.
"Hal ini perlu diambil kira semasa memilih rakan setangki" – a generalisation not stated in the facts.
"jadi pilih rakan setangki dengan berhati-hati" is a mild recommendation not in the facts; the facts only say semi-aggressive.
"Perkara ini normal." is a mild generalisation. The facts only say adults can take on a green or blue tint.
"Namun, kebanyakan sumber mengaitkannya dengan Pterophyllum scalare": the facts only give the base species. They do not say that most sources link it to that species.

"Ada juga penjual yang menjual stok bermata merah sebagai platinum": the facts only say that one wholesaler describes its stock as red-eyed. They do not say that sellers pass red-eyed fish off as platinum. This is a mild extrapolation.
"Di alam liar ia hanya ditemui di hulu Sungai Kapuas, Borneo Barat" - fine, but the page says the fish is "bukan hasil kacukan" and "membiak dengan baka yang tulen" - OK per facts.

"Sesetengah pembeli menilai terutamanya dari segi warna ... Ada juga yang mementingkan bentuk badan" - facts attribute these to southern and northern Vietnamese buyers; the page drops the regional framing (minor generalisation).
"Penjaga yang berpengalaman menekankan bahawa penapisan yang baik paling penting" - the facts say Vietnamese keepers; 'berpengalaman' is an unsupported embellishment.
"Perlu diingat bahawa pemberian ikan loach bercanggah dengan nasihat Seriously Fish" - this is the page's own inference, not in the facts.
"Ikan ini pemangsa yang boleh mencapai 60–90 cm" - supported by the sizes, but the lead summary merges sources.
"Banjar Red: kacukan yang biasa" - the facts also say Vietnamese hobbyists list Banjar Red separately as Hồng long, which the page omits; the omission is not an error.
"Penggemar sering mengaitkan drop eye ... " and "Ramai penggemar menganggap cip ini sebagai sijil kelahiran" - 'ramai' (many) is slightly stronger than the facts' 'Vietnamese hobbyists'.
"Ikan ini sukar dipelihara." Facts give a difficulty rating of 4 but no wording for it. This is a small generality.
"hidup sekitar 20 tahun" in the intro. Sources give 20–25 and 20 years. This is a minor simplification.
"Hampir semua ikan yang dijual sekarang dibiakkan di ladang". Facts say fish in the trade are bred on farms, with no "hampir semua".
"Jika mahu meletakkan rakan setangki" and "Berhati-hatilah dengan janji gred yang terlalu yakin" are mild embellishments not in the facts.
"gunakan pemanas apabila suhu turun" paraphrases "use a heater in winter". It is roughly supported.
"Banjar Red ... Ia sering dianggap kumpulan yang berasingan" is a loose reading of the fact that Vietnamese hobbyists list it as Hồng long, separate from Huyết long.
"mikrocip yang menunjukkan ladang berdaftar CITES" in the FAQ. Facts say the chip shows which farm bred the fish, not that the farm is CITES-registered, though CITES farms are mentioned elsewhere.
